title: Identifying an anion
caption: Test in this order so earlier ions do not interfere: dilute acid first (carbonate fizzes), then acidified barium chloride (sulfate gives a white precipitate), then acidified silver nitrate (halides).
alt: A tree: fizzing with dilute acid? carbonate. Otherwise white precipitate with BaCl₂? sulfate. Otherwise precipitate with AgNO₃: white chloride, cream bromide, yellow iodide.
description: Add dilute HNO₃: fizzing, and the gas turns limewater milky: carbonate.
Add acidified BaCl₂: white precipitate: sulfate.
Add acidified AgNO₃: white (chloride), cream (bromide) or yellow (iodide).

q1.q: Fizzes with dilute acid, gas turns limewater milky?
